Method: see the docstrings of `analysis/twoblock_stats.py` and `analysis/nginx_stats.py` (two-block per-cell test). Estimate = geometric mean of the two blocks' mean(B)/mean(A) ratios, each block against its own baselines; 95 % CI by test inversion; p = exact stratified permutation over 28² = 784 arrangements (min 1.28e-03); q = Benjamini-Hochberg over the 96 tests (throughput excluded: manipulation check). Floor = 2 × single-run SD × √((1/6 + 1/2)/2) from 48 baseline pairs. "effect" needs q < 0.05 and |estimate| ≥ floor.
